"Heaven" is a song by American glam metal band Warrant.
The power ballad was released in July 1989 as the second single from Warrant's debut album, Dirty Rotten Filthy Stinking Rich.
The song is Warrant's most commercially successful single, spending two weeks at number two on the US Billboard Hot 100 and number three on the Billboard Album Rock Tracks chart.
